title: Where the Lord Reveals His Presence
description: Where the Lord Reveals His Presence in Tonic Solfa to OMNI DIE, doh is F: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: John Brownlie translated these words from the Greek service books for Hymns from the Morningland (Paisley, 1911).
The book printed the words without tunes. They are in Eights and Sevens (8.7.8.7), and this page sets them to OMNI DIE; any other Eights and Sevens tune fits them as well.
underlay: Where the Lord re-veals His pre-sence, Glo-ry lights the sa-cred place, And the soul in a-dor-a-tion Falls be-fore the throne of grace.

lines: Where the Lord reveals His presence,
Falls before the throne of grace.
Lift their songs where Christ is set,
Light of lights, no light approacheth, —
Sun, nor moon, nor stars of night,
Flood the noon-tide and the darkness
Ere we rise to where Thou art,
Let the glory of Thy presence
Chase the darkness from our heart.

source: John Brownlie, Hymns from the Morningland (1911)
licence: Public domain: John Brownlie died in 1925.
credits: Translated by John Brownlie (1857–1925) from the Greek, public domain, as printed in Hymns from the Morningland; set to OMNI DIE by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
